indian_disaster_events.annotation_method: Rapid mapping storm surge swath + post-event optical damage grading
indian_disaster_events.notes: Sundarbans coastal embankment breaches and severe structural roof scouring in South 24 Parganas.

indian_disaster_events.data_source: ASDMA / NRSC Bhuvan Flood Archive / Copernicus

indian_disaster_events.annotation_method: Urban inundation perimeter mapped via SAR amplitude difference
